adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real pagination bug. Looking at the diff, when `removeMember` is called (line 45), it calls `self.findMembers()` to reload. The `findMembers` function (lines 23-37) uses the current offset value: `var offset = Math.min(this.get('user_count'), Math.max(this.get('offset'), 0))`. If a user is on page 2 (offset=50) of a 51-member group and removes the only member on that page, the user_count becomes 50, but the offset remains 50. The `Math.min(50, 50)` keeps offset at 50, which would return an empty page since there are only 50 members (indices 0-49). The pagination controls show `showingLast` as true when `currentPage == totalPages`, so the user cannot navigate. This is a legitimate edge-case bug in the pagination logic.
